concept_v2.png.prompt: The attached image is an APPROVED app design, given only as a style reference. Design a NEW launcher icon for this app in the SAME visual language: its palette (#2F6B3F forest green, #F7F4EC warm paper, #1F2A22 ink), rendering style, lighting and mood. Do NOT reproduce the screenshot or any illustration or scene in it (no landscape, horizon, water or card); invent a simple icon composition. Brief: Veil, a Chrome extension that blurs private chats (WhatsApp Web, Telegram, Messenger) until you hover; calm, trustworthy, premium privacy tool. Must read clearly at 16x16 px in a browser toolbar: one bold simple shape, no fine detail.. Direction: a bold lowercase-free abstract V formed by two folds of a draped veil. Square 1:1 canvas. One bold, simple central subject with a strong silhouette that still reads at 48 px, centred and about 60% of the canvas wide so circular masks never cut it, on a solid or smooth-gradient background with little or no texture. No text, letters or numbers anywhere.
